scenario.summary: VerdantBamboo compromised an organization's Egnyte Storage Sync and Synology NAS appliances using credentials stolen from a breached Managed Service Provider. The actor deployed the BRICKSTORM backdoor and AGENTPSD python shell, using the appliances as proxies to access Microsoft 365 environments and evade conditional access policies.

meta.rationale: Focus the hunt on Linux-based appliances (Storage Sync, Synology, pfSense) and servers in the DMZ. These devices are VerdantBamboo's primary targets for evading EDR.
meta.hypothesis: A compromised system is performing command-and-control over DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) to bypass network inspection, evidenced by TLS connections to public DNS resolvers from unusual binaries.

hunt.name: VerdantBamboo: Evasive Outbound C2 via DoH
hunt.description: This hunt identifies signs of the BRICKSTORM implant, which uses DNS-over-HTTPS (specifically to Google's 8.8.8.8) to resolve Cloudflare-fronted C2 domains. By correlating network connections to public resolvers with the absence of local DNS logs and the presence of rare binaries in system directories like /usr/sbin/, we can identify hosts evading standard DNS-based filtering and monitoring.

config.scoping_notes: Focus the hunt on Linux-based appliances (Storage Sync, Synology, pfSense) and servers in the DMZ. These devices are VerdantBamboo's primary targets for evading EDR.
config.beyond_detection: A standard rule might detect any 8.8.8.8:443 traffic, but this hunt adds the critical context of process path analysis (/usr/sbin), host-wide DNS prevalence stacking, and an agent-driven triage of 'DNS silence' to filter out legitimate browser-based DoH.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, dst_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) as connection_count, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE dst_endpoint_port = 443 AND instr(',' || '{{public_dns_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, process_path, dst_endpoint_ip
config.description: Find hosts making TLS connections to public DNS resolvers on port 443.
config.expected_signal: A list of processes and hosts connecting to Google or Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS. Browsers are expected; non-browser system binaries (e.g., in /usr/sbin) are highly suspicious.

primitive_config.label: Identify DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) Traffic
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, dst_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) as connection_count, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE dst_endpoint_port = 443 AND instr(',' || '{{public_dns_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, process_path, dst_endpoint_ip
primitive_config.expected: A list of processes and hosts connecting to Google or Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS. Browsers are expected; non-browser system binaries (e.g., in /usr/sbin) are highly suspicious.

config.content: SELECT process_name, process_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count, COUNT(*) as connection_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE dst_endpoint_port = 443 AND instr(',' || '{{public_dns_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, process_path HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Identify rare binaries making DoH connections across the fleet.
config.expected_signal: A binary that only appears on one or two hosts and is not a standard web browser.

primitive_config.label: Stack-Count DoH-Capable Processes
primitive_config.content: SELECT process_name, process_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count, COUNT(*) as connection_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE dst_endpoint_port = 443 AND instr(',' || '{{public_dns_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, process_path HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: A binary that only appears on one or two hosts and is not a standard web browser.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, COUNT(query_hostname) as dns_queries, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT query_hostname) as sample_queries FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname HAVING dns_queries < 100
config.description: Verify the absence of standard DNS traffic for hosts doing DoH.
config.expected_signal: Hosts with very low standard DNS volume relative to their uptime, suggesting redirection to DoH or other channels.

primitive_config.label: Check for DNS Silence
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, COUNT(query_hostname) as dns_queries, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT query_hostname) as sample_queries FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname HAVING dns_queries < 100
primitive_config.expected: Hosts with very low standard DNS volume relative to their uptime, suggesting redirection to DoH or other channels.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, user_name, on_disk, COUNT(*) as count FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/usr/sbin/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/usr/local/libexec/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/home/egnyteservice/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, process_path, user_name, on_disk
config.description: Look for binaries in system paths that are not typically seen running or are not on disk.
config.expected_signal: A binary like 'blacklist' or 'ssync' or a generic name in /usr/sbin/ that is not a standard system daemon.

primitive_config.label: Check System Path Binary Rarity
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, user_name, on_disk, COUNT(*) as count FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/usr/sbin/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/usr/local/libexec/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/home/egnyteservice/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, process_path, user_name, on_disk
primitive_config.expected: A binary like 'blacklist' or 'ssync' or a generic name in /usr/sbin/ that is not a standard system daemon.

config.objective: Determine if any host shows the pattern of: (1) Rare process in a system path like /usr/sbin, (2) Outbound TLS to 8.8.8.8, and (3) Absence of standard DNS activity for the same time window.
config.description: Analyze network, process, and DNS activity to confirm if a host is compromised by BRICKSTORM.
config.expected_signal: A verdict on whether the identified processes and network traffic constitute a BRICKSTORM-style DoH C2 channel.
config.success_criteria: Verdicts for each host citing process names, network endpoints, and DNS volume.

config.question: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host based on DoH traffic from rare system-path binaries
config.condition: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host based on DoH traffic from rare system-path binaries
config.description: Route findings based on the agent's confidence.
Prevent further C2 and lateral movement from the compromised appliance.
config.instructions: Isolate the host immediately. Prioritize Linux VMs and firewall appliances. Collect memory and /usr/sbin binaries for forensic analysis.

config.description: Manually confirm the presence of BRICKSTORM and identify any secondary implants like AGENTPSD.
config.instructions: Review the processes flagged by the agent. Check crontab files for entries like 'egnyte_host_monitor_client' (AGENTPSD) and verify if the SSL VPN was used as a pivot point. Check for root-level sudo abuse of 'tee' or 'rsync'.
If no malicious activity was found, document the hosts scanned and the lack of DoH/suspicious processes.
